title: Science: Habitats 🏕️
summary:
1. What is a Habitat?
A habitat is a natural home or environment for animals and plants. It provides living things with food, water, and shelter.

2. Kinds of Habitats & Their Environments:
🏜️ Desert: Very hot, dry, and bright. (Example country: Egypt).
🌴 Tropical Rainforest: Very warm, wet, and has many tall trees. Monkeys and orchids live here. (Example country: Brazil).
❄️ Polar: Very cold, icy, and snowy. Only a few plants can grow here. (Example region: Antarctica or Canada).
🌾 Grassland: Warm, open fields with lots of grass and few trees. (Example country: Kenya or Australia).
🌊 Aquatic: A water habitat, like oceans, lakes, and rivers. Seaweeds and fish live here.

3. Habitats for Plants:
Just like animals, plants also need a habitat! A habitat gives a plant the right soil, sunlight, and water it needs to grow.
